definitions.short: strictly a demonstrative particle, here ; but used of time, now or then
definitions.full: H645. epho אֵפוֺ ( Job 17:15 ; 19:6 , 23 ; 24:25 ), elsewhere אֵפוֺא (compare רִבּוֺ and רִבּוֺא ), enclitic particle then (probably from מּוֺ , a particle with a demonstrative force, compare מֹּה מּוֺ, here, with א prefixed. In the Targs. מּוֺן is used somewhat similarly, e.g. Gen 26:10 ; Num 11:29 ; Isa 1:9 ; 48:18-19 ,), — used 1 in connection with interrogatory pronouns or adverbs (like ἄρα , ποτε tandem): אֵפוֺא מִי Gen 27:3 who, then , . . . ? 27:37 ; אֶעֱשֶׂה מָה אֵפוֺא וּלְכָה and for thee, then , what shall I do, my son ? Exod 33:16 אֵפוֺא יִוָּדַע וּבַמֶּה and wherein shall it be known, then ...? אֵפוֺא אַיה where, then ? Judg 9:38 ; Isa 19:12 ; Job 17:15 ; Hosea 13:10 אֵפוֺא מַלְכְךָ אֱהִי Isa 22:1 אֵפוֺא מַהלָּֿח what is there to thee, pray . . .. 2 in a command or wish : 2Kin 10:10 אֵפוֺא דְּעוּ ? know, then ; (in apodosis) Prov 6:3 ; Job 19:6 , 23 מִלָּי֑ וְיִכָּֽתְבוּן אֵפוֺ מִיּיִֿתֵּן would, then , that my words were written ! 3 after אִם Gen 43:11 עֲשׂו זאֹת אֵפוֺא אִםכֵּֿן if it be so, then , do this, Job 9:24 if not then , who is it ? 24:25 .
